# Notipus
# https://notipus.com

## About
Notipus delivers beautifully enriched Slack notifications for payment events from Stripe, Shopify, and Maxio. Payment notifications that spark joy.

## Features
- Stripe, Shopify, Maxio integrations
- Slack notifications with customer context
- Smart insights and churn risk detection
- Lifetime value and engagement tracking
- Failed payment and trial expiration alerts

## Open Source
Repository: https://github.com/Notipus/Notipus
